column3: NKJV includes “I, John,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “from heaven,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “from the throne.”
NKJV has “shall inherit all things,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “shall inherit these things.”
NKJV has “the great city, the holy Jerusalem,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the holy city Jerusalem.”
NKJV has “the nations of those who are saved” and “glory and honor,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the nations” and “glory.”
